decisions.reason: After two selling cycles and the earlier withdrawal of weaker new carpets, this surviving close-to-core carpet likely sits at or above the firm's aspiration level, though the category is still being actively pruned.

The hand-knotted wool-silk carpet fits the firm's design and craftsmanship identity, but as a narrower premium niche it faces somewhat higher aspiration pressure now that management has had more time to assess results.
The corner bench builds directly on the established furniture and project business, so in a growing market it is likely to remain comfortably within aspiration levels and worth retaining.
The swivel shell chair line is close to the core offer and spans several models, giving it broad customer use and learning value that make continuation the most likely choice.
